description: Experimental research build, NOT verified on device. Adds a bytecode branch so Android Auto routing can use Maps' existing two-wheeler mode instead of DRIVE when the projected vehicle is CAR. Compiled successfully against the official Morphe build pipeline; fingerprints have NOT yet been checked against a real Google Maps install, and the patch has not been applied, installed, or tested on any phone or head unit. See findings.md and handoff.md in this repository for full scope, evidence, and limitations before relying on this.
